notes: Turns material normalized operational changes into deterministic, goal-aligned Today recommendations through versioned Restaurant & Café Knowledge Pack rules.
Eligibility is limited to gross-sales, orders, repeat-orders and delivery-time changes of at least 10% over exactly 7 or 28 days; zero comparisons and historical evidence are excluded.
Recommendations preserve exact change and Signal provenance, use observational non-causal copy, remain business-isolated and retain existing ranking, cooldown and no-filler behavior.
No migration, connector change, raw-file retention, customer PII, external action, mobile change, deployment, release or production enablement is authorized.

approvals.rationale: Product Owner approved the written VS-39 design and instructed implementation to proceed.
Product Owner approved deterministic provider-neutral matching with Restaurant & Café category rules, non-causal wording, exact provenance, PII exclusion and no-filler behavior.
Product Owner selected inline execution and instructed Atlas to continue; implementation remains feature-branch only and subject to exact-head certification.
